verdict.rationale: Chargebee documents an in-product AI assistant that lets users 'answer questions and complete tasks' via natural language inside the Billing UI, plus AI-driven drafting of pricing/plans from a description, and MCP servers that let external AI clients (Cursor, Claude, ChatGPT) operate Chargebee capabilities conversationally. This is first-party doc evidence only, with no independent/hands-on corroboration of how robust or complete the natural-language command coverage actually is. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on validation of the AI assistant's command coverage, and detail on which actions can be fully executed vs. only queried via natural language.
